<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD is a standard Arch Linux package build file for the `lat.md` Node.js application. The `package()` function runs `npm install -g` with `--ignore-scripts` and `--omit=dev` flags to install the application into `$pkgdir`, which is ordinary packaging behavior. Cleanup operations via `find` remove platform-specific binaries (.node files for darwin/win32/musl), transient npm directories (man caches, .cache), and internal metadata (keys matching `_.+` in package.json via jq). The `latestver()` function fetches the version from the package's own upstream npm registry — the expected source. A valid sha256sum checksum is provided (not `SKIP`). There are no `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash`, or similar patterns that execute untrusted code. No data exfiltration, reverse shells, backdoors, or modifications to unrelated system files are present. All operations are consistent with routine maintenance of a Node.js application package.

The `--ignore-scripts` flag is a security-conscious choice to prevent npm lifecycle scripts from executing during installation; it is not itself malicious. The jq filtering of underscore-prefixed keys removes internal npm metadata, which is standard packaging cleanup. No genuinely malicious or supply-chain-attack behavior is detected.
</details>
